versos.hebraico: וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה וְאֶֽל־אַהֲרֹ֖ן לֵאמֹֽר׃

controles.web: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
controles.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses and to Aaron, saying,
controles.livre: E falou o SENHOR a Moisés e a Arão, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: דַּבְּרוּ֙ אֶל־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַאֲמַרְתֶּ֖ם אֲלֵהֶ֑ם אִ֣ישׁ אִ֗ישׁ כִּ֤י יִהְיֶה֙ זָ֣ב מִבְּשָׂר֔וֹ זוֹב֖וֹ טָמֵ֥א הֽוּא׃

controles.web: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When any man has a discharge from his body, because of his discharge he is unclean.
controles.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When any man hath a running issue out of his flesh, because of his issue he is unclean.
controles.livre: Falai aos filhos de Israel, e dizei-lhes: Qualquer homem, quando seu corrimento sair de sua carne, será impuro.

versos.hebraico: וְזֹ֛את תִּהְיֶ֥ה טֻמְאָת֖וֹ בְּזוֹב֑וֹ רָ֣ר בְּשָׂר֞וֹ אֶת־זוֹב֗וֹ אֽוֹ־הֶחְתִּ֤ים בְּשָׂרוֹ֙ מִזּוֹב֔וֹ טֻמְאָת֖וֹ הִֽוא׃

controles.web: This shall be his uncleanness in his discharge: whether his body runs with his discharge, or his body has stopped from his discharge, it is his uncleanness.
controles.kjv: And this shall be his uncleanness in his issue: whether his flesh run with his issue, or his flesh be stopped from his issue, it is his uncleanness.
controles.livre: E esta será sua impureza em seu fluxo; seja que sua carne derramou por causa de seu fluxo, ou que sua carne se obstruiu por causa de seu fluxo, ele será impuro.

versos.hebraico: כָּל־הַמִּשְׁכָּ֗ב אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִשְׁכַּ֥ב עָלָ֛יו הַזָּ֖ב יִטְמָ֑א וְכָֽל־הַכְּלִ֛י אֲשֶׁר־יֵשֵׁ֥ב עָלָ֖יו יִטְמָֽא׃

controles.web: “‘Every bed whereon he who has the discharge lies shall be unclean; and everything he sits on shall be unclean.
controles.kjv: Every bed, whereon he lieth that hath the issue, is unclean: and every thing, whereon he sitteth, shall be unclean.
controles.livre: Toda cama em que se deitar o que tiver fluxo, será impura; e toda coisa sobre que se sentar, impura será.

versos.hebraico: וְאִ֕ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִגַּ֖ע בְּמִשְׁכָּב֑וֹ יְכַבֵּ֧ס בְּגָדָ֛יו וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־הָעָֽרֶב׃

controles.web: Whoever touches his bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.
controles.kjv: And whosoever toucheth his bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
controles.livre: E qualquer um que tocar em sua cama, lavará suas roupas; lavará também a si mesmo com água, e será impuro até à tarde.

versos.hebraico: וְהַיֹּשֵׁב֙ עַֽל־הַכְּלִ֔י אֲשֶׁר־יֵשֵׁ֥ב עָלָ֖יו הַזָּ֑ב יְכַבֵּ֧ס בְּגָדָ֛יו וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־הָעָֽרֶב׃

controles.web: He who sits on anything whereon the man who has the discharge sat shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.
controles.kjv: And he that sitteth on any thing whereon he sat that hath the issue shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
controles.livre: E o que se sentar sobre aquilo em que se houver sentado o que tem fluxo, lavará suas roupas, se lavará também a si mesmo com água, e será impuro até à tarde.

versos.hebraico: וְהַנֹּגֵ֖עַ בִּבְשַׂ֣ר הַזָּ֑ב יְכַבֵּ֧ס בְּגָדָ֛יו וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־הָעָֽרֶב׃

controles.web: “‘He who touches the body of him who has the discharge shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.
controles.kjv: And he that toucheth the flesh of him that hath the issue shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
controles.livre: Também o que tocar a carne do que tem fluxo, lavará suas roupas, e a si mesmo se lavará com água, e será impuro até à tarde.

versos.hebraico: וְכִֽי־יָרֹ֛ק הַזָּ֖ב בַּטָּה֑וֹר וְכִבֶּ֧ס בְּגָדָ֛יו וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־הָעָֽרֶב׃

controles.web: “‘If he who has the discharge spits on him who is clean, then he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.
controles.kjv: And if he that hath the issue spit upon him that is clean; then he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
controles.livre: E se o que tem fluxo cuspir sobre o limpo, este lavará suas roupas, e depois de haver-se lavado com água, será impuro até à tarde.

versos.hebraico: וְכָל־הַמֶּרְכָּ֗ב אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִרְכַּ֥ב עָלָ֛יו הַזָּ֖ב יִטְמָֽא׃

controles.web: “‘Whatever saddle he who has the discharge rides on shall be unclean.
controles.kjv: And what saddle soever he rideth upon that hath the issue shall be unclean.
controles.livre: E toda sela sobre que cavalgar o que tiver fluxo, será impura.

versos.hebraico: וְכָל־הַנֹּגֵ֗עַ בְּכֹל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִהְיֶ֣ה תַחְתָּ֔יו יִטְמָ֖א עַד־הָעָ֑רֶב וְהַנּוֹשֵׂ֣א אוֹתָ֔ם יְכַבֵּ֧ס בְּגָדָ֛יו וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־הָעָֽרֶב׃

controles.web: Whoever touches anything that was under him shall be unclean until the evening. He who carries those things shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.
controles.kjv: And whosoever toucheth any thing that was under him shall be unclean until the even: and he that beareth any of those things shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
controles.livre: E qualquer um que tocar qualquer coisa que tenha estado debaixo dele, será impuro até à tarde; e o que a levar, lavará suas roupas, e depois de lavar-se com água, será impuro até à tarde.

versos.hebraico: וְכֹ֨ל אֲשֶׁ֤ר יִגַּע־בּוֹ֙ הַזָּ֔ב וְיָדָ֖יו לֹא־שָׁטַ֣ף בַּמָּ֑יִם וְכִבֶּ֧ס בְּגָדָ֛יו וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־הָעָֽרֶב׃

controles.web: “‘Whoever he who has the discharge touches, without having rinsed his hands in water, he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.
controles.kjv: And whomsoever he toucheth that hath the issue, and hath not rinsed his hands in water, he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
controles.livre: E todo aquele a quem tocar o que tem fluxo, e não lavar com água suas mãos, lavará suas roupas, e a si mesmo se lavará com água, e será impuro até à tarde.

versos.hebraico: וּכְלִי־חֶ֛רֶשׂ אֲשֶׁר־יִגַּע־בּ֥וֹ הַזָּ֖ב יִשָּׁבֵ֑ר וְכָל־כְּלִי־עֵ֔ץ יִשָּׁטֵ֖ף בַּמָּֽיִם׃

controles.web: “‘The earthen vessel, which he who has the discharge touches, shall be broken; and every vessel of wood shall be rinsed in water.
controles.kjv: And the vessel of earth, that he toucheth which hath the issue, shall be broken: and every vessel of wood shall be rinsed in water.
controles.livre: E a vasilha de barro em que tocar o que tem fluxo, será quebrada; e toda vasilha de madeira será lavada com água.

versos.hebraico: וְכִֽי־יִטְהַ֤ר הַזָּב֙ מִזּוֹב֔וֹ וְסָ֨פַר ל֜וֹ שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֛ים לְטָהֳרָת֖וֹ וְכִבֶּ֣ס בְּגָדָ֑יו וְרָחַ֧ץ בְּשָׂר֛וֹ בְּמַ֥יִם חַיִּ֖ים וְטָהֵֽר׃

controles.web: “‘When he who has a discharge is cleansed of his discharge, then he shall count to himself seven days for his cleansing, and wash his clothes; and he shall bathe his flesh in running water, and shall be clean.
controles.kjv: And when he that hath an issue is cleansed of his issue; then he shall number to himself seven days for his cleansing, and wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in running water, and shall be clean.
controles.livre: E quando se houver limpado de seu fluxo o que tem fluxo, se há de contar sete dias desde sua purificação, e lavará suas roupas, e lavará sua carne em águas vivas, e será limpo.

versos.hebraico: וּבַיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁמִינִ֗י יִֽקַּֽח־לוֹ֙ שְׁתֵּ֣י תֹרִ֔ים א֥וֹ שְׁנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֣י יוֹנָ֑ה וּבָ֣א׀ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֗ה אֶל־פֶּ֨תַח֙ אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד וּנְתָנָ֖ם אֶל־הַכֹּהֵֽן׃

controles.web: “‘On the eighth day he shall take two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, and come before Yahweh to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and give them to the priest:
controles.kjv: And on the eighth day he shall take to him two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, and come before the Lord unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and give them unto the priest:
controles.livre: E no oitavo dia tomará duas rolinhas, ou dois pombinhos, e virá diante do SENHOR à porta do tabernáculo do testemunho, e os dará ao sacerdote:

versos.hebraico: וְעָשָׂ֤ה אֹתָם֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן אֶחָ֣ד חַטָּ֔את וְהָאֶחָ֖ד עֹלָ֑ה וְכִפֶּ֨ר עָלָ֧יו הַכֹּהֵ֛ן לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה מִזּוֹבֽוֹ׃ס

controles.web: and the priest shall offer them, the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering. The priest shall make atonement for him before Yahweh for his discharge.
controles.kjv: And the priest shall offer them, the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering; and the priest shall make an atonement for him before the Lord for his issue.
controles.livre: E os fará o sacerdote, uma oferta pelo pecado, e o outro holocausto: e lhe purificará o sacerdote de seu fluxo diante do SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: וְאִ֕ישׁ כִּֽי־תֵצֵ֥א מִמֶּ֖נּוּ שִׁכְבַת־זָ֑רַע וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֛יִם אֶת־כָּל־בְּשָׂר֖וֹ וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־הָעָֽרֶב׃

controles.web: “‘If any man has an emission of semen, then he shall bathe all his flesh in water, and be unclean until the evening.
controles.kjv: And if any man’s seed of copulation go out from him, then he shall wash all his flesh in water, and be unclean until the even.
controles.livre: E o homem, quando dele sair derramamento seminal, lavará em águas toda sua carne, e será impuro até à tarde.

versos.hebraico: וְכָל־בֶּ֣גֶד וְכָל־ע֔וֹר אֲשֶׁר־יִהְיֶ֥ה עָלָ֖יו שִׁכְבַת־זָ֑רַע וְכֻבַּ֥ס בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־הָעָֽרֶב׃פ

controles.web: Every garment, and every skin, whereon the semen is, shall be washed with water, and be unclean until the evening.
controles.kjv: And every garment, and every skin, whereon is the seed of copulation, shall be washed with water, and be unclean until the even.
controles.livre: E toda vestimenta, ou toda pele sobre a qual houver o derramamento seminal, lavará com água, e será impura até à tarde.

versos.hebraico: וְאִשָּׁ֕ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִשְׁכַּ֥ב אִ֛ישׁ אֹתָ֖הּ שִׁכְבַת־זָ֑רַע וְרָחֲצ֣וּ בַמַּ֔יִם וְטָמְא֖וּ עַד־הָעָֽרֶב׃

controles.web: If a man lies with a woman and there is an emission of semen, they shall both bathe themselves in water, and be unclean until the evening.
controles.kjv: The woman also with whom man shall lie with seed of copulation, they shall both bathe themselves in water, and be unclean until the even.
controles.livre: E a mulher com quem o homem tiver ajuntamento seminal, ambos se lavarão com água, e serão impuros até à tarde.

versos.hebraico: וְאִשָּׁה֙ כִּֽי־תִהְיֶ֣ה זָבָ֔ה דָּ֛ם יִהְיֶ֥ה זֹבָ֖הּ בִּבְשָׂרָ֑הּ שִׁבְעַ֤ת יָמִים֙ תִּהְיֶ֣ה בְנִדָּתָ֔הּ וְכָל־הַנֹּגֵ֥עַ בָּ֖הּ יִטְמָ֥א עַד־הָעָֽרֶב׃

controles.web: “‘If a woman has a discharge, and her discharge in her flesh is blood, she shall be in her impurity seven days: and whoever touches her shall be unclean until the evening.
controles.kjv: And if a woman have an issue, and her issue in her flesh be blood, she shall be put apart seven days: and whosoever toucheth her shall be unclean until the even.
controles.livre: E quando a mulher tiver fluxo de sangue, e seu fluxo for em sua carne, sete dias estará separada; e qualquer um que tocar nela, será impuro até à tarde.

versos.hebraico: וְכֹל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר תִּשְׁכַּ֥ב עָלָ֛יו בְּנִדָּתָ֖הּ יִטְמָ֑א וְכֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־תֵּשֵׁ֥ב עָלָ֖יו יִטְמָֽא׃

controles.web: “‘Everything that she lies on in her impurity shall be unclean. Everything also that she sits on shall be unclean.
controles.kjv: And every thing that she lieth upon in her separation shall be unclean: every thing also that she sitteth upon shall be unclean.
controles.livre: E tudo aquilo sobre que ela se deitar durante sua separação, será impuro: também tudo aquilo sobre que se sentar, será impuro.

versos.hebraico: וְכָל־הַנֹּגֵ֖עַ בְּמִשְׁכָּבָ֑הּ יְכַבֵּ֧ס בְּגָדָ֛יו וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־הָעָֽרֶב׃

controles.web: Whoever touches her bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.
controles.kjv: And whosoever toucheth her bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
controles.livre: E qualquer um que tocar a sua cama, lavará suas roupas, e depois de lavar-se com água, será impuro até à tarde.

versos.hebraico: וְכָל־הַנֹּגֵ֔עַ בְּכָל־כְּלִ֖י אֲשֶׁר־תֵּשֵׁ֣ב עָלָ֑יו יְכַבֵּ֧ס בְּגָדָ֛יו וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־הָעָֽרֶב׃

controles.web: Whoever touches anything that she sits on shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.
controles.kjv: And whosoever toucheth any thing that she sat upon shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
controles.livre: Também qualquer um que tocar qualquer móvel sobre que ela se houver sentado, lavará suas roupas; lavará logo a si mesmo com água, e será impuro até à tarde.

versos.hebraico: וְאִ֨ם עַֽל־הַמִּשְׁכָּ֜ב ה֗וּא א֧וֹ עַֽל־הַכְּלִ֛י אֲשֶׁר־הִ֥וא יֹשֶֽׁבֶת־עָלָ֖יו בְּנָגְעוֹ־ב֑וֹ יִטְמָ֖א עַד־הָעָֽרֶב׃

controles.web: If it is on the bed, or on anything whereon she sits, when he touches it, he shall be unclean until the evening.
controles.kjv: And if it be on her bed, or on any thing whereon she sitteth, when he toucheth it, he shall be unclean until the even.
controles.livre: E se estiver sobre a cama, ou sobre a cadeira em que ela se houver sentado, o que tocar nela será impuro até à tarde.

versos.hebraico: וְאִ֡ם שָׁכֹב֩ יִשְׁכַּ֨ב אִ֜ישׁ אֹתָ֗הּ וּתְהִ֤י נִדָּתָהּ֙ עָלָ֔יו וְטָמֵ֖א שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֑ים וְכָל־הַמִּשְׁכָּ֛ב אֲשֶׁר־יִשְׁכַּ֥ב עָלָ֖יו יִטְמָֽא׃פ

controles.web: “‘If any man lies with her, and her monthly flow is on him, he shall be unclean seven days; and every bed whereon he lies shall be unclean.
controles.kjv: And if any man lie with her at all, and her flowers be upon him, he shall be unclean seven days; and all the bed whereon he lieth shall be unclean.
controles.livre: E se alguém dormir com ela, e sua menstruação for sobre ele, será impuro por sete dias; e toda cama sobre que dormir, será impura.

versos.hebraico: וְאִשָּׁ֡ה כִּֽי־יָזוּב֩ ז֨וֹב דָּמָ֜הּ יָמִ֣ים רַבִּ֗ים בְּלֹא֙ עֶת־נִדָּתָ֔הּ א֥וֹ כִֽי־תָז֖וּב עַל־נִדָּתָ֑הּ כָּל־יְמֵ֞י ז֣וֹב טֻמְאָתָ֗הּ כִּימֵ֧י נִדָּתָ֛הּ תִּהְיֶ֖ה טְמֵאָ֥ה הִֽוא׃

controles.web: “‘If a woman has a discharge of her blood many days not in the time of her period, or if she has a discharge beyond the time of her period; all the days of the discharge of her uncleanness shall be as in the days of her period: she is unclean.
controles.kjv: And if a woman have an issue of her blood many days out of the time of her separation, or if it run beyond the time of her separation; all the days of the issue of her uncleanness shall be as the days of her separation: she shall be unclean.
controles.livre: E a mulher, quando seguir o fluxo de seu sangue por muitos dias fora do tempo de seu costume, ou quando tiver fluxo de sangue mais de seu costume; todo o tempo do fluxo de seu imundícia, será impura como nos dias de seu costume.

versos.hebraico: כָּל־הַמִּשְׁכָּ֞ב אֲשֶׁר־תִּשְׁכַּ֤ב עָלָיו֙ כָּל־יְמֵ֣י זוֹבָ֔הּ כְּמִשְׁכַּ֥ב נִדָּתָ֖הּ יִֽהְיֶה־לָּ֑הּ וְכָֽל־הַכְּלִי֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תֵּשֵׁ֣ב עָלָ֔יו טָמֵ֣א יִהְיֶ֔ה כְּטֻמְאַ֖ת נִדָּתָֽהּ׃

controles.web: Every bed whereon she lies all the days of her discharge shall be to her as the bed of her period: and everything whereon she sits shall be unclean, as the uncleanness of her period.
controles.kjv: Every bed whereon she lieth all the days of her issue shall be unto her as the bed of her separation: and whatsoever she sitteth upon shall be unclean, as the uncleanness of her separation.
controles.livre: Toda cama em que dormir todo o tempo de seu fluxo, lhe será como a cama de seu costume; e todo móvel sobre que se sentar, será impuro, como a impureza de seu costume.

versos.hebraico: וְכָל־הַנּוֹגֵ֥עַ בָּ֖ם יִטְמָ֑א וְכִבֶּ֧ס בְּגָדָ֛יו וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־הָעָֽרֶב׃

controles.web: Whoever touches these things shall be unclean, and shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.
controles.kjv: And whosoever toucheth those things shall be unclean, and shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
controles.livre: Qualquer um que tocar em essas coisas será impuro; e lavará suas roupas, e a si mesmo se lavará com água, e será impuro até à tarde.

versos.hebraico: וְאִֽם־טָהֲרָ֖ה מִזּוֹבָ֑הּ וְסָ֥פְרָה לָּ֛הּ שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֖ים וְאַחַ֥ר תִּטְהָֽר׃

controles.web: “‘But if she is cleansed of her discharge, then she shall count to herself seven days, and after that she shall be clean.
controles.kjv: But if she be cleansed of her issue, then she shall number to herself seven days, and after that she shall be clean.
controles.livre: E quando for livre de seu fluxo, se há de contar sete dias, e depois será limpa.

versos.hebraico: וּבַיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁמִינִ֗י תִּֽקַּֽח־לָהּ֙ שְׁתֵּ֣י תֹרִ֔ים א֥וֹ שְׁנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֣י יוֹנָ֑ה וְהֵבִיאָ֤ה אוֹתָם֙ אֶל־הַכֹּהֵ֔ן אֶל־פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃

controles.web: On the eighth day she shall take two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, and bring them to the priest, to the door of the Tent of Meeting.
controles.kjv: And on the eighth day she shall take unto her two turtles, or two young pigeons, and bring them unto the priest, to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
controles.livre: E o oitavo dia tomará consigo duas rolinhas, ou dois pombinhos, e os trará ao sacerdote, à porta do tabernáculo do testemunho:

versos.hebraico: וְעָשָׂ֤ה הַכֹּהֵן֙ אֶת־הָאֶחָ֣ד חַטָּ֔את וְאֶת־הָאֶחָ֖ד עֹלָ֑ה וְכִפֶּ֨ר עָלֶ֤יהָ הַכֹּהֵן֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה מִזּ֖וֹב טֻמְאָתָֽהּ׃

controles.web: The priest shall offer the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering; and the priest shall make atonement for her before Yahweh for the uncleanness of her discharge.
controles.kjv: And the priest shall offer the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering; and the priest shall make an atonement for her before the Lord for the issue of her uncleanness.
controles.livre: E o sacerdote fará um oferta pelo pecado, e o outro holocausto; e a purificará o sacerdote diante do SENHOR do fluxo de sua impureza.

versos.hebraico: וְהִזַּרְתֶּ֥ם אֶת־בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מִטֻּמְאָתָ֑ם וְלֹ֤א יָמֻ֨תוּ֙ בְּטֻמְאָתָ֔ם בְּטַמְּאָ֥ם אֶת־מִשְׁכָּנִ֖י אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּתוֹכָֽם׃

controles.web: “‘Thus you shall separate the children of Israel from their uncleanness, so they will not die in their uncleanness, when they defile my tabernacle that is in their midst.’”
controles.kjv: Thus shall ye separate the children of Israel from their uncleanness; that they die not in their uncleanness, when they defile my tabernacle that is among them.
controles.livre: Assim separareis os filhos de Israel de suas imundícias, a fim de que não morram por suas imundícias, contaminando meu tabernáculo que está entre eles.

versos.hebraico: זֹ֥את תּוֹרַ֖ת הַזָּ֑ב וַאֲשֶׁ֨ר תֵּצֵ֥א מִמֶּ֛נּוּ שִׁכְבַת־זֶ֖רַע לְטָמְאָה־בָֽהּ׃

controles.web: This is the law of him who has a discharge, and of him who has an emission of semen, so that he is unclean thereby;
controles.kjv: This is the law of him that hath an issue, and of him whose seed goeth from him, and is defiled therewith;
controles.livre: Esta é a lei do que tem fluxo, e do que sai derramamento seminal, vindo a ser impuro por causa disso;

versos.hebraico: וְהַדָּוָה֙ בְּנִדָּתָ֔הּ וְהַזָּב֙ אֶת־זוֹב֔וֹ לַזָּכָ֖ר וְלַנְּקֵבָ֑ה וּלְאִ֕ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִשְׁכַּ֖ב עִם־טְמֵאָֽה׃פ

controles.web: and of her who has her period, and of a man or woman who has a discharge, and of him who lies with her who is unclean.
controles.kjv: And of her that is sick of her flowers, and of him that hath an issue, of the man, and of the woman, and of him that lieth with her that is unclean.
controles.livre: E da que padece seu costume, e acerca do que tiver fluxo, seja homem ou fêmea, e do homem que dormir com mulher impura.
